budgets.storageOverheadNote: No persistent telemetry storage — scheduler metrics are in-process AtomicU64 counters only; zero disk writes from observability layer

overheadMeasurement.mechanism: tracing static level filter — a single Relaxed atomic load per disabled callsite

enabledCallsiteCost.mechanism: fetch_add with Relaxed ordering on AtomicU64
enabledCallsiteCost.notes: Each SchedulerMetrics.record_*() call is one fetch_add(Relaxed) — estimated ≤2ns. For 10 scheduler events per 100ms interactive operation, this is 20ns overhead = 0.00002% of budget.

securityRecoveryPreservation.mechanism: tracing level hierarchy: ERROR and WARN always propagate regardless of subscriber filter level
securityRecoveryPreservation.guarantee: Any subscriber configured at INFO-or-higher preserves all security/recovery events; DEBUG/TRACE can be safely dropped without losing observability of recovery or security paths

adaptiveSamplingPolicy.description: Adaptive sampling is implemented via subscriber-level filter configuration

levels.example: outbox relay dead-letter promotion after RELAY_MAX_ATTEMPTS

examples: startup integrity check failed → Recovery_Mode entry

levels.droppedUnderPressure: configurable — dropped when subscriber at WARN-only

examples: cold-start skipped file with in-content secret
levels.droppedUnderPressure: yes — dropped when subscriber at INFO-or-higher (near-zero overhead when disabled)

storageOverhead.mechanism: SchedulerMetrics uses 7 × AtomicU64 = 56 bytes in-process; no telemetry writes to SQLite authority or disk
storageOverhead.healthReportStorage: Computed on demand from existing authority tables — no separate telemetry table exists
storageOverhead.notes: Observability layer adds exactly 56 bytes of in-process state (SchedulerMetrics struct). No background telemetry writer, no telemetry DB, no periodic flush. Storage overhead = 0 bytes on disk.

hardwareCampaignNotes: Actual CPU profiling and interactive-latency measurement under load require hardware runs per dev-context.md.
